protocol: Conditional input-error scenarios and one-at-a-time coherent cascade perturbations; not calibrated confidence/prediction intervals
distribution: Independent mean-one lognormal multipliers per development record and supplied wave anchor; one shared dry-density draw per trial
recalibration: Original mass tau/Minf training fit and full-history swelling alpha recomputed for each perturbed development dataset; blend weights frozen
upstream_draw_reuse: Mass, thickness and velocity draws are unaffected by the density restoration; cached draws verified against a full upstream refit at trial 1 of each scenario. All 1536 changed modulus predictions recomputed.
exact_modulus_evaluation: Fully grown one-feature forests with fixed feature positions and bootstrap draws have an exact linear prediction map. This map was checked against 24 full forest refits at the three input-error levels to 1e-10 absolute tolerance. Nearly equal labels use the full refit fallback. This computational optimization does not change the fitted model or predictions.
density_model: Original effective arithmetic mass-fraction blend; thickness is not a density input.
provenance_note: Source record hashes refreshed after explanatory metadata changes; numerical predictions and fitted settings are unchanged.
